authoritative_rule.statement: SCHEMA → CAPABILITY → NOT_FOUND → CARDINALITY → PRECONDITION → OK
authoritative_rule.application: NOT_FOUND > CARDINALITY when one required reference has 0 matches and another has >1 matches
